svg.title: Arduino Uno R3 + HC-SR04 — verified pin-to-pin wiring
svg.desc: Authentic Fritzing board and component artwork with wires anchored at connector locations from the Fritzing part definitions. See the on-page table for each pin pair and source links.
svg.text: Fritzing-style reference · board and module art from cited parts library
Diagram artwork includes Fritzing parts by althaus (Arduino Uno R3) and Richard Bruneau (HC-SR04), from fritzing/fritzing-parts.
Graphics are licensed CC BY-SA 3.0. The colored wires and pin-to-pin mapping are TU Archive additions.
